notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by paying {4}{B}, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield, and then returning Corpse Dance to your hand.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{B}.
Repeat.
If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.
